dishes.make_ahead: Crush the peanuts up to 3 days ahead; whisk the batter, cut the bananas and fry just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the flour, cornflour, sugar, salt and soda water into a smooth batter.
Cut the bananas into chunks and crush the peanuts.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip the banana in batter and fry in batches.
Drain, drizzle with honey and scatter with peanuts.

dishes.n: Kevin's cheddar and pecan cheese ball
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, wrapped and chilled; roll in the pecans to serve

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, mustard and paprika until smooth.
Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 1 hour.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan until fragrant, then cool.
Roll the ball in the pecans and serve with the crackers.

dishes.n: Orlando buttermilk fried chicken and biscuits
dishes.make_ahead: Soak the chicken up to a day ahead in the fridge; bake the biscuits and fry the chicken on the day

steps.text: Soak the chicken in 500ml of the buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours in the fridge.
Rub 80g of the cold butter into the self-raising flour, stir in the rest of the buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick and cut 8 rounds.
Bake the biscuits at 220°C until risen and golden.
Mix the plain flour with the paprika, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper, and heat the oil to 170°C.
Dredge the chicken and fry in batches until golden and cooked through.
Beat the rest of the butter with the honey and serve with the chicken and biscuits.

veg.n: Orlando buttermilk fried cauliflower and biscuits
veg.make_ahead: Soak the cauliflower up to a day ahead in the fridge; bake the biscuits and fry on the day

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower in 500ml of the buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 1 hour in the fridge.
Rub 80g of the cold butter into the self-raising flour, stir in the rest of the buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick and cut 8 rounds.
Bake the biscuits at 220°C until risen and golden.
Mix the plain flour with the paprika, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper, and heat the oil to 170°C.
Dredge the cauliflower and fry in batches until golden and tender.
Beat the rest of the butter with the honey and serve with the cauliflower and biscuits.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the fudge sauce up to 5 days ahead, keep chilled and reheat gently; whip the cream and assemble on the night

ingredients.item: thickened cream, whipped, for the topping

steps.text: Chop the chocolate. Heat the cream for the fudge and pour over the chocolate, stirring into a hot fudge.
Heat.
Whip the cream for the topping. Split the bananas lengthways into long dishes.
Add three scoops of ice cream to each, pour over the fudge and top with cream and a cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended just before serving; chill the tall glasses in the freezer up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Blend the bananas, ice cream, milk and some of the caramel until thick and smooth.
Drizzle caramel inside four tall glasses and pour in the shake.
Top with whipped cream, a banana slice and a final drizzle of caramel.
